Rates are in percent. Record date 2026-10-30, payment date 2026-11-16, all validity tested against the payment date.

RECONCILIATION TO NOTICE DOC-0201
- Gross: 12,000,000.00 (D-001-A dividend 10,000,000; D-001-B return of capital 2,000,000). Matches the notice and the treasury lines.
- Tax: 1,510,562.50, all on D-001-A.
- Net: 10,489,437.50.

DECISIONS FOR THE REVIEWER
1. I-006 Meridian Holdings I — default 30% (tax 90,000). Its clearance CL-006 still reads cleared to 2027-12-31, but it rests on an ownership fact that ended 2026-07-31. The restructuring (DOC-0106) leaves it 70% owned by Meridian Family Trust (Jersey) and 30% by Meridian Holdings II, which is itself 30% owned by Meridian Holdings I, a circular holding. Change case K-006 has been open since 2026-08-20 with no outcome. The trust has no tax form or residence record. I did not rely on the clearance for the ownership-based treaty claim. If K-006 re-clears it before payment, the rate is 15% (tax 45,000, net 255,000) and the schedule returns to step 9.
2. I-003 Kirchberg Industries — 5% (tax 62,500). Its effective vote in Orion is 12.5% x 80% = exactly 10.0%, the minimum for R-03. I treated "at least 10%" as met and counted the holding through the fund and the disregarded SPV. If you do not accept either point, the rate is 15% (tax 187,500).
3. I-015 Bertrange Capital — default 30% (tax 150,000). Its form ended 2025-12-31 and clearance was withdrawn on 2026-01-01 after no reply. No cure case is open; a new W-8BEN-E before payment would need WF2 and a return to step 9.
4. I-014 Client account 7731 — default 30% (tax 67,500) on 37.5% of Sterling Nominees' share, undocumented since admission.

REDUCED RATES TO REVIEW (C3.3)
- 15% under R-02 v2026.1, US-Luxembourg convention Article 10: I-001, I-004, I-005, I-008, I-010, I-011, I-013.
- 5% under R-03 v2026.1, same article: I-003 only.
- Near misses on the 10% vote test, all on register vote percentages x 80%: I-004 at 9.99%; I-010 at 9.6% through the feeder; I-005 at 8.0%, because its Class B units carry 10% of votes against 13% economic (economic share would give 10.4%); I-001 at 8.0%.
- I-001 and I-013 are pension funds. The rulebook holds no pension-specific rate, so they are at 15%.

LOOK-THROUGH
- Atlas Lux Feeder (I-002, payee CP-102, 2,400,000 + 480,000) is transparent; its lines are split 50/30/20 to I-010, I-011 and I-012 per the feeder register.
- Sterling Nominees (I-007, payee CP-107, 600,000 + 120,000) is a nonqualified intermediary; its lines are split 62.5/37.5 to I-013 and I-014 per the withholding statement DOC-0107.
- The treasury payment file is at payee level, so it needs the netted figures: CP-102 tax 432,000; CP-107 tax 123,750.

DATA POINTS
- Two investors are named Alpha Holdings SA: I-008 (Luxembourg, treaty, 15%) and I-009 (Switzerland, no treaty claim, 30%). Amounts match their registration numbers and counterparties CP-108 and CP-109.
- Atlas Co-Invest Vehicle (I-016) is 3.0% in the investor register and the treasury lines but 3.5% in entity management (H-006). I used 3.0%, which reconciles to 100%. Fund finance should confirm.
- The record date is still in the future. The investor list reflects the register today and must be re-frozen at 2026-10-30; any change returns to step 9.
- I could not read the LPA (DOC-0001, not digitised), so I could not confirm that holds are permitted and used default rates instead.
- The procedure is marked illustrative and not practitioner-reviewed. Rates come from the rulebook (R-01, R-02, R-03, version 2026.1) only.

NOTICES BEFORE PAYMENT (C3.7, investor relations)
- I-015: new W-8BEN-E needed.
- I-007, for I-014: tax certification for the beneficial owner of client account 7731.
- I-006: completion of K-006, with documented ownership up to the ultimate owners, including Meridian Holdings II and Meridian Family Trust."}
